metadata.title: Molecula — AI Creative Production Operating System
metadata.description: Molecula is a connected creative production platform for AI images, video, film, music, voice, scripts, characters, and worlds — taking a project from idea to finished export in one place.

hero.headline: Create. Direct. Produce.
hero.subhead: Molecula is a connected creative production platform for producing images, video, film, music, voice, characters, and worlds — as one continuous project, not a pile of disconnected tools.

philosophy.heading: Project first. Tools second.
philosophy.body: Most AI tools generate an asset and stop. Molecula produces a project — carrying continuity, characters, and creative direction across every stage, from the first idea to the final export.

pipeline.heading: One project, every discipline
pipeline.description: A single Molecula project moves through a connected production pipeline, the way a real studio does — not as isolated generations.

items.name: Image
items.description: Direction-aware image generation for stills, keyframes, and concept art.

items.name: Video
items.description: Shot-level AI video production with continuity across scenes.

items.name: Film
items.description: Full movie projects — script to screen, one production timeline.

items.name: Music
items.description: Original score and sound design generated for the scene, not the loop.

items.name: Voice
items.description: Character-consistent AI voice across languages and takes.

items.name: Script
items.description: AI-assisted scriptwriting tied directly to characters and scenes.

items.name: Characters
items.description: Persistent characters carried across every scene and medium.

items.name: Storyboard
items.description: Auto-generated storyboards from script and visual direction.

items.name: 3D & Previs
items.description: Environments and previsualization for spatial, physical scenes.

items.name: Auto Director
items.description: AI direction that keeps shots, pacing, and coverage intentional.

items.name: Continuity AI
items.description: Automatic continuity checking across characters, scenes, and takes.

items.name: Auto Editing
items.description: Assembly-first editing that respects the project's direction.
